::: {#rem-question-partition-source}
#### Questions as sets of answers in semantics

@hamblin1973questions took a question in natural language to denote the set of propositions that count as its answers,
so that a question "sets up a choice-situation between a set of propositions".
Those answers need not exclude one another.
@groenendijk1984studies took a question's answers to be mutually exclusive and to cover every possibility,
so that a question partitions the possibilities.
@def-question follows Groenendijk and Stokhof:
the possible answers of a question partition $\srcalph$.

:::
